Title: (LSJ) Question about Flames of the Netherworld and allies.

Messages.Author: jari mäkikyrö
Messages.Body:
Hello

Can Samuel Haight/ Talaq, The Immortal/ Rafastio Ghoul play Flames of
the Netherworld at thaumaturgy?
So can ally burn blood/(life) as a vampire when it plays combat card?

Flames of the Netherworld, Combat
Thaumaturgy: Only usable at long range. This vampire burns 1 blood to
strike for 1R aggravated damage.
Daimoinon: Strike: 1 aggravated damage.
DAIMOINON: Strike: 1R aggravated damage.

Rafastio Ghoul, Ally, 3 Pool
Ghoul with 2 life. 1 bleed, 1 strength.
Rafastio Ghoul can play cards requiring basic Thaumaturgy as a
vampire with a capacity of 3.

Samuel Haight, Ally, 5 Pool
Unique werewolf with 4 life. 3 strength, 0 bleed.
Once each action, Samuel may burn a life to get +1 bleed. He may steal
equipment as a strike. He may play cards requiring basic Celerity or
basic Thaumaturgy as a vampire. Any vampire may call a referendum to
make Samuel become Red List as a +1 stealth political action. If
Samuel has less than 4 life during your untap phase, he gains 1 life
from the blood bank.

Talaq, The Immortal, Ally, 3 Pool
Unique mage with 3 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
Talaq may strike for 1R damage. Talaq may play cards that require
basic Quietus or basic Thaumaturgy as a vampire with a capacity of
3. Talaq gets an optional maneuver each combat.

Bio
